notes: The three cells are plain-text derivations for the Derivation Board (INS-derivation), which is not built yet; wp_transfer.py states each line as the cells' @direction describes it, and the cells are committed verbatim beside it.

In S4.L2 cell 2 the post bal(x) + bal(y) + bal(z) = S is a formula in a free S, so "the weakest preconditions disagree" is a state and an S where one sum equals S and the other does not; x, y and z are not assumed distinct. S4.L2 cell 2's @call cites RUN-z3-selftransfer; its instrument cites this run.
S4.L3 cell 1 states no amount > 0, so none is assumed; the disagreement's witness may have amount = 0.

Recorded with the bench image built from bench/image/Dockerfile (a local build; the digest is its manifest list's, never pushed). Each configuration ran once, in a fresh container with the run's cells mounted read-only at /w; <sandbox>/work stands for the scratch copy of runs/RUN-z3-wp-transfer/cells/.
Every verdict line is copied from the logs; values.configs.<config>.lines is parsed from those lines by label (slugged), and the other values are read from that parse, never typed.
Recorded for the W1 report's follow-up 1 (task_label: W1-followup-1). run@1's task field must match W<n>-S<nn> or W<n>-T<nn>, which that name does not, so the record leaves task out.
Z3's model values are not canonical: a witness is checked by its property, never matched by value.
